conceptBlocks.text: 移动平均平滑短期波动；环比比较本期与上一自然期的变化率。三行窗口只有在每月一行且日期连续时才代表三个月。首两月可按已有行计算，也可按严格完整窗口口径返回空值，必须明确。

syntax.purpose: 2 PRECEDING 前两行；CURRENT ROW 包含当前行。

problem: 月度销售报表按连续月份统计，移动平均允许不足三个月取已有记录，环比为百分数，首月和零分母不计算。

methodBlocks.text: 内层公用表表达式同时计算 LAG 和 AVG。外层使用 100.0*(sales-prev)/NULLIF(prev,0)；先减后除，分母为上期，最后舍入。
严格三月口径还需要检查窗口内有效值数。

breakdown.title: 逐月补充上期销售与移动平均
breakdown.sql: WITH m AS (SELECT month,sales,LAG(sales) OVER(ORDER BY month) AS prev,AVG(sales) OVER(ORDER BY month ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg FROM monthly) SELECT * FROM m ORDER BY month;
breakdown.purpose: 逐月补充上期销售与移动平均（m）的实际执行结果。
breakdown.reason: 在示例数据上运行该步骤，核对中间结果后再进入下一步。

columns.name: month
columns.mysqlType: VARCHAR(160) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin

completeCode.mysqlSql: WITH m AS (SELECT month,sales,LAG(sales) OVER(ORDER BY month) AS prev,AVG(sales) OVER(ORDER BY month ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg FROM monthly) SELECT month,ROUND(moving_avg,2) AS avg3,ROUND(100.0*(sales-prev)/NULLIF(prev,0),2) AS growth_pct FROM m ORDER BY month;
completeCode.sqliteSql: WITH m AS (SELECT month,sales,LAG(sales) OVER(ORDER BY month) AS prev,AVG(sales) OVER(ORDER BY month ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg FROM monthly) SELECT month,ROUND(moving_avg,2) AS avg3,ROUND(100.0*(sales-prev)/NULLIF(prev,0),2) AS growth_pct FROM m ORDER BY month;

resultBlocks.text: 二月均值1250，环比50%；三月均值1333.33，环比0%；四月均值1300，环比-40%。首月环比未知。

extensions.label: 严格完整窗口

explanationBlocks.text: 仅在三个有效月均存在时给出平均。

extensions.sql: SELECT month,CASE WHEN COUNT(sales) OVER w=3 THEN ROUND(AVG(sales) OVER w,2) END AS full_avg FROM monthly WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY month ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) ORDER BY month;

explanationBlocks.text: 上期为零时，即使本期为正也不能计算普通环比。

comparison.text: 移动平均描述平滑水平，不是增长率。

example.text: 把本期当分母，或将首期环比填成0。

correction.text: 使用上期非零值为分母；无上期保留空值。

notes.text: 月份缺失先补时间轴；未知销售不能自动当作零。
